positions.name: MeridianGateRationale
positions.frame: what is the signed manifest gate for Meridian deployments and why was it introduced?
positions.why: src-1 declares the gate requirement (signed release manifest before any Meridian deployment ships) and src-2 supplies the motivating incident — two unsigned artifacts reached staging last quarter. The directional read spans the policy statement and its causal origin as a single coherent unit.

positions.name: MeridianGateParameters
positions.frame: what are the key parameters of the Meridian deployment gate decision?
positions.why: src-4, src-5, and src-6 are Xena ExpertGH's summary of the three decision parameters — the gate itself, its scope (staging and production), and its owner (Quinton Fairweather) — all animated by Xena with Quinton Fairweather as principal. They cohere under one directional read: the structured parameters of the gate decision.
